scope: offline long-only Strict-R3 :00-only feature research; no live, canonical, exchange, admission, portfolio, or execution artifact modified
purpose: Extend the development-only <=30-field stability selector to the predeclared target-free F4 execution-context and F5 asset-divergence families, and enforce the mandatory quarterly policy>=100 recall gate for every selected family.

contracts.family_source: F2/F3 and F4/F5 are materialised through their own predeclared target-free source loaders; no label, outcome, future path, or held-window rank is an input to feature construction or scoring.
contracts.selection: Only development folds ending before 2025-10-01 may contribute gain stability; selected extras are capped at 30 and require top-30 and non-zero importance in at least half of development folds.
contracts.advancement: A selected family must satisfy the fixed-30% recall, policy-mean, rank-IC, and no-quarterly-decline-in-policy>=100 gates before a downstream rebuild can be considered.
